_note: Researcher-authored claims for wraith. Every phrase is backed by checks re-run against the game files at validation time. Authored 2026-10-24 by the captions agent from abilities.vdata + citadel_mods localisation.

Ricochet.phrase: Bounced bullets carry your bullet procs, so Tesla Bullets' shock gets extra rolls on up to 2 more enemies within 13m at 65% damage when they stand together.
Ricochet.note: Text says ricochet applies 'any bullet procs'; Tesla Bullets is a per-bullet proc (REG proc). Whether ricochet hits also feed Card Trick's card meter is NOT claimed (unknown).

Capacitor.phrase: Chain count goes from 4 to 6 and damage per chain from 33 to 43; the new part is a projectile that slows by up to 60% and silences movement abilities, on a 40s item cooldown.

checks.contains: Silences their movement-based items and abilities

Escalating Exposure.phrase: Each spirit hit adds 4.5% spirit amp, at most one stack per 0.7s, so 12 stacks (54%) take about 8.4s of continuous spirit damage on one target: it pays off in long fights, not in a card burst.

Silencer.phrase: The silence lasts 2.5s and the target is then immune for 10s, so you get one silence per target roughly every 12.5s: save the build-up for an escape or a key cast.

Spiritual Overflow.phrase: Charges up while you hit enemy heroes, paying out +30 spirit, +25% fire rate and +10% spirit lifesteal; Full Auto T3 removes reloads while it lasts, which keeps you shooting.

checks.contains: charging up when shooting enemy heroes
